Product QA Report · autonomous run

GRWAI — Get Ready with AI

Expo SDK 54 · React Native 0.81.5 · expo-router 6 · repository ~/grwai on harshas-macbook-air (Harsha) · tested as the web build of the React Native app in headless Chromium (Playwright) with the exact package-lock.json.

DateTuesday, September 29, 2026
Overall statusPASS WITH ISSUES
Overall confidenceMEDIUM
Checks executed34 routes · 101 journey assertions · 65 responsive captures · 34 axe runs

Executive summary

The implemented screens are a faithful, token-disciplined rendering of DESIGN_SYSTEM.md v1.7: every text node on every explored route uses one of the five loaded brand faces, zero text colours and zero radii fall outside the token scale, no screen overflows horizontally at 375–1440px, and the onboarding flow works end-to-end with correct persistence (email, prefs, swipes, archetype, completion flag; password never stored). The events flow (sheet → manual form with date/location pickers → card; mock calendar OAuth with a real 2-second loading state) and the moment composer also behave as intended.

What does not yet match the intended product is mostly missing or stubbed surface area rather than broken rendering: the outfit-detail screen is declared but does not exist (the hero card is inert and its pagination dots are decorative), the Saved tab is a placeholder, Iris never answers a typed message, and the You profile CTA is a dead stub. Two defects are real rendering/runtime bugs: every tab-bar label was clipped to a 9px box on all tab screens, and the web target crashed to a blank page at boot. Three low-risk fixes were applied in the cloud working copy only (never to the repo), re-tested, and left no regressions (101/101 checks reproduce the same 13 product findings before and after).

Scope limits, stated plainly. (1) Figma is not available for this repository — no Figma URLs, exports or MCP links exist in the repo or the project — so "intended design" was reconstructed from DESIGN_SYSTEM.md v1.7 (53 KB, in-repo), BUILD_SPEC.md, the project-level onboarding mockup grwai-onboarding-flow.html (13 phone frames), the locked decisions memory, constants/theme.ts, and in-code comments. Mappings from those sources are labelled inferred where the sources disagree. (2) The app was executed on web; iOS/Android were not run. Findings marked "web-only" do not affect Expo Go; findings on layout arithmetic that also applies natively are marked "device confirmation required". (3) Live integrations (fal.ai scene generation, YouCam try-on, camera capture) were not exercised — no credentials were pulled from the Mac and no camera exists in the sandbox.

Phase 1 — Product understanding

What it is: GRWAI ("Get Ready with AI") — a mobile-first AI styling app. Iris, the stylist, reads calendar, weather and closet and proposes outfits rendered as photoreal scenes of the user. User: a single consumer (mock user "Harsha", San Francisco). Stack: Expo Router file routes, Zustand + AsyncStorage persistence, Reanimated, Lucide icons, expo-camera/file-system/haptics, react-native-web. Existing tests: none automated beyond tsc --noEmit (passes) and expo lint (3 errors / 10 warnings); a /design-test component gallery exists for manual QA.

Critical / high issues

GRW-01 HIGH Runtime · Web target

ScreenAll screens (web)
Expected`npm run web` (a configured script; react-native-web + web.output=static are set up) boots the app.
ActualBlank page, no fonts, uncaught SyntaxError: Cannot use 'import.meta' outside a module. Reproduced with the exact package-lock.json (zustand 5.0.13) and with ^-range installs (5.0.15).
EvidenceSmoke run #1 (pre-fix): pageErrors=["SyntaxError: Cannot use 'import.meta' outside a module"], text="", fonts=[]. Bundle grep: node_modules/zustand/esm/middleware.mjs lines with import.meta.env (module id 3010). Native is unaffected: Expo's Metro uses the react-native export condition (zustand CJS) for ios/android but browser/import on web.
Likely causeCONFIRMED. babel-preset-expo only polyfills import.meta when unstable_transformImportMeta is true (see babel-preset-expo/build/import-meta-transform-plugin.js); the repo has no babel.config.js.
Suggested fixApplied as Fix Experiment #1 (verified): add babel.config.js with [['babel-preset-expo', { unstable_transformImportMeta: true }]] (preset resolved from expo/ because it is not hoisted in this lockfile). Alternative: alias zustand/middleware to its CJS build in metro.config.js for web.

GRW-02 HIGH Requirement · Missing screen

ScreenToday → Outfit detail
ExpectedBUILD_SPEC §4.5–4.6: tapping the hero outfit card navigates to /outfit/[outfitId] (name, price, blurb, component pills, action chips). Pagination dots indicate a swipeable 3-card carousel.
Actualapp/outfit/ is an empty directory; /outfit/soft-power renders expo-router's "Unmatched Route" page. The hero Card has no onPress; only one outfit is rendered and the 3 dots are static decoration. Every launch logs [Layout children]: No route named "outfit/[outfitId]" exists.
EvidenceJourney check "Tapping hero outfit card opens outfit detail" → stays on /. Console warning on every route visit (34/34).
Likely causeCONFIRMED. app/_layout.tsx:99 declares <Stack.Screen name="outfit/[outfitId]"> but no file exists; app/(tabs)/index.tsx:245 renders <Card variant="featured"> without a press handler.
Suggested fixImplement app/outfit/[outfitId].tsx per §4.6 and pass onPress={() => router.push(`/outfit/${featuredOutfit.id}`)}; render a real horizontal carousel (or remove the dots until one exists).

GRW-03 HIGH Behavior · Core loop

ScreenStylist (Iris chat)
ExpectedBUILD_SPEC §6.3: "When user taps a suggestion or sends a message: Iris message: avatar + timestamp + rich outfit card".
ActualTyping a message and pressing Send appends the user bubble and nothing else — no Iris reply, no loading state, no error, after 3.5 s (and 6.5 s in the follow-up probe). Only the photo-attach → category path produces Iris turns.
EvidenceJourney check "Iris responds to a typed message" FAIL; screenshot below.
Likely causeCONFIRMED. app/stylist.tsx:164-173 sendMessage() only does setTurns([...prev, {kind:'user_text'}]) and clears the input — there is no response path for free text.
Suggested fixRoute free text into the same turn machine as attachments (at minimum an iris_running turn + a scripted acknowledgement / "Tell me the moment" hand-off to the composer), or hide the free-text input until a response backend exists.

GRW-04 HIGH Visual · Tab bar

ScreenAll 5 tab screens
ExpectedDESIGN_SYSTEM §7.6: 64px + safe-area tab bar, 24px icon, label/sm 13/16 label in sentence case, fully visible.
ActualEvery label ("Today", "Events", …) is clipped at the baseline — the label Text box measures 9px tall (line-height 16px) at 375, 390 and 1440 widths.
EvidenceDOM measurement: tab item content = 41px (bar 76 − paddingTop 8 − item paddingVertical 16 − react-navigation 5+5) vs 48px needed (icon ≈28 + margin 4 + label 16) → label flex-shrunk to 9px with overflow:hidden (numberOfLines=1). Screenshot below (before) vs after Fix #3.
Likely causeCONFIRMED on web. app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: fixed height: 64 + (ios ? 24 : 12) plus paddingTop: 8 on the bar and paddingVertical: 8 on items. The same arithmetic applies on iOS/Android (iOS: 88 − 30 inset padding − 16 − 10 = 32px) — device confirmation required.
Suggested fixApplied as Fix Experiment #3 (verified: label box 16px, bottom 834 < 844): size the bar as theme.layout.tabBarHeight + insets.bottom via useSafeAreaInsets() and drop the two extra paddings (react-navigation already adds 5px).

GRW-05 HIGH Requirement · Safety / policy

ScreenOnboarding (age gate, teen track, consent)
ExpectedDesign mockup grwai-onboarding-flow.html (screens 0, 3, 10·t) + locked product decision "Under-18 users should never receive photoreal full-body generation": an age gate before anything else, an explicit likeness-consent tap ("I agree — add my photo"), and a guardian-approved board mode for minors.
ActualNo age/date-of-birth step exists anywhere in app/onboarding/*; no teen/board track; consent is implied by reading a trust list on face-intro and tapping "Take face photo" (no explicit agreement). BUILD_SPEC §16 does not list these screens.
EvidenceRoute inventory (14 onboarding routes) and text extraction of every screen: no "birthday", "under 18", "guardian" or "I agree" copy.
Likely causeCONFIRMED absence. Whether this is deferred scope or an omission is a product decision — BUILD_SPEC is silent, the mockup and decisions memory require it.
Suggested fixDecide explicitly: add the age gate + consent screens to BUILD_SPEC §16 (and implement), or document them as out-of-scope for this build. Until then the photoreal path has no minor safeguard.

Medium issues (visual · behavioral · design-system · accessibility · responsive · missing states)

GRW-06 MEDIUM Runtime · Web

ScreenOnboarding face-intro / body-intro ("Skip for now")
ExpectedBUILD_SPEC §16.6: in __DEV__, Skip fills the URI from a bundled placeholder so QA can step through the flow.
ActualOn web the tap throws Uncaught Error: RNImage.default.resolveAssetSource is not a function (LogBox), and the flow cannot continue past face-intro.
EvidenceLogBox screenshot below; journey blocked at step 22 before the fix, passes after.
Likely causeCONFIRMED. Image.resolveAssetSource is native-only (not implemented by react-native-web). face-intro.tsx:36, body-intro.tsx:33.
Suggested fixApplied as Fix Experiment #2 (verified): guard with typeof RNImage.resolveAssetSource === 'function' and fall back to the asset module's uri. Cleaner long-term: Asset.fromModule(mod).uri from expo-asset.

GRW-07 MEDIUM Runtime · Web

ScreenApp start (all screens)
ExpectedNo uncaught exceptions at launch.
ActualEvery page load throws TypeError: this.validatePath is not a function (uncaught) plus two "expo-file-system is not supported on web" warnings.
Evidence34/34 explored routes recorded the same pageerror. Stack: new Directory → Paths.document → getPhotoDir → getPhotoFile → copySlot.
Likely causeCONFIRMED. lib/photoStorage.ts (via profilePhotosStore hydration) and wardrobeStorage.ts, youcam/cache.ts, scene/sceneGenerator.ts construct expo-file-system Directory/File objects with no Platform.OS === 'web' guard.
Suggested fixWrap file-system access in a platform guard / try-catch that resolves to null on web, or mark web as unsupported in app.json and remove the web script.

GRW-13 MEDIUM Accessibility · Contrast (token-level)

ExpectedDESIGN_SYSTEM §2.1/§12: ink/tertiary #8A8A8A is "AA-compliant 4.5:1"; WCAG AA for text.

Phase 9 — User journey results

Onboarding — full flow (fresh user) PASS (after Fix #2 on web)

  1. Land on / → soft-gate redirect to /onboarding/welcome
  2. Welcome CTA gated ≈1.8 s, then Get started
  3. Account: invalid email / short password / mismatch show inline errors; Create disabled until valid; show-password toggle
  4. Name: Continue gated on name; identity single-select; always-honor multi-select; self-describe input
  5. Face-intro → capture (camera permission primer) → back → Skip (DEV placeholder)
  6. Body-intro skip → colour analysis loading (2.5 s) → reveal → Looks right
  7. Life-context toggle → figure (fit required, optional shape) → 8 + 8 swipes via Love/Pass

Phase 11 — Accessibility

Automated (axe-core 4, WCAG 2.1 A/AA + best-practice, 34 routes)

RuleImpactRoutesNodesVerdict
color-contrastserious2248FAIL — token-level (GRW-13)
aria-prohibited-attrserious18FAIL — colour swatches (GRW-22)
document-titleserious3434FAIL — web only (GRW-21)
region / landmark-one-mainmoderate33226UNCERTAIN — react-native-web emits no landmarks; not actionable in app code
Everything else (labels, roles, names, lists, duplicate ids, …)—340 violationsPASS

Deterministic checks

  • Tap targets <44px (visible, interactive): onboarding Back 24×24 on 13 screens, Skip 29×20, header icon buttons 36×36 (bell, bag, add-piece, close, attach, send), "Close preview" 32×32, dev pills 28px tall, chips 38px tall (by design). FAIL against DS §12 (GRW-14).
  • Keyboard: 11 logical stops on the account screen, visible focus outline, Enter activates chips, disabled buttons removed from the tab order. PASS (web).
  • Names/roles: every pressable exposes role=button with a label or text; SaveButton label/hint/state per §7.13; swipe deck has Love/Pass buttons as a gesture alternative. PASS
  • Selected state: accessibilityState.selected is set on chips/tabs but react-native-web 0.21 does not emit aria-selected. FAIL (web only).

Requires manual review

  • VoiceOver / TalkBack reading order and hint verbosity on device; Dynamic Type scaling (§12 says display sizes cap at 130%) — not verifiable on web.
  • Reduce-motion: Welcome handles it (AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled); colour/taste pulse, swipe deck and sheet springs do not check it.
  • Haptics (first-save-only rule) — device only.
  • Photoreal alt text ("You wearing [outfit] in [scene]") — no renders exist to inspect.

The three diffs are saved beside this report as fixes/patches/ (unified diffs + the babel config) — nothing was written to the repository on the Mac.

What works well (verified, not assumed)

  • Soft-gate routing, resume banner, and every persisted onboarding field (13 screens, 40 checks) — including the security detail that the password is never written to storage.
  • Form validation on the account screen matches spec (inline error copy, 1.5px error border, disabled CTA until valid, show/hide password).
  • Design-token discipline: fonts, colours and radii are 100% on-token across 34 routes; eyebrow → headline → content rhythm and the one-italic-word rule hold on every hero screen.
  • Events: sheet → manual form (real calendar/time and location pickers, sync switch) → card with correct summary counts; mock OAuth with a genuine loading state; FEATURED / Trips / MULTI-DAY behave per §5.2.
  • Moment composer parses natural language ("Dinner with friends in SoHo on Friday at 8pm" → 🥂 Dinner · Fri, Oct 2) and asks the next question.
  • Always-honor preferences round-trip between onboarding, the You summary and the Always honor screen (single prefs store).
  • SaveButton, EmptyState, ProgressDots, Pill, Input and EventMoodHeader match their DS entries on measurement; keyboard operability and accessible names are in place.
  • No horizontal overflow at any tested width; no broken assets or failed requests.

What requires human review

  • Run on an iPhone/Android: does the tab-bar clipping (GRW-04) reproduce natively, and does Fix #3's 64 + inset height look right on a home-indicator device?
  • Product decision on GRW-05 (age gate, consent tap, teen board mode) — implement or explicitly de-scope.
  • Camera capture, photo library, live scene generation (fal.ai) and YouCam try-on — not exercised (no device, no credentials).
  • Closet populated state, piece detail, try-on and the "ON YOU · N" badge — need real pieces.
  • Past-events section and delete confirmation — need seed data or a past-dated moment (the picker blocks past dates).
  • GRW-08 (Reanimated overlap) — confirm whether it is web-only.
  • Whether desktop web is a target at all (decides GRW-21 and whether the web script should stay).
  • Screen-reader and Dynamic Type behaviour on device.

Most important fixes (priority order, by user impact)

  1. GRW-03 — make Iris respond (or gate free text). The core promise of the app currently ends in silence.
  2. GRW-02 — ship the outfit-detail screen and a real carousel, or remove the dead affordances; every Today session hits this.
  3. GRW-04 — merge the tab-bar sizing fix (patch 03) after a device check; it affects every tab screen.
  4. GRW-05 — decide and implement the minor-safety gate before any photoreal path goes live.
  5. GRW-13 / GRW-14 — correct the tertiary token and header hit-slop; cheap, spec-level, app-wide.
  6. GRW-09 / GRW-10 / GRW-11 — Saved tab, You CTA, inert header controls: remove or wire.
  7. GRW-01 / GRW-06 / GRW-07 — only if web remains a target: merge patches 01–02 and platform-guard expo-file-system.
  8. GRW-17 / GRW-18 — reconcile the two spec files with the code and strip the QA traces before review.

Final question — would I allow this application to proceed to human product/design review?

YES WITH CONDITIONS

Why yes: the parts that exist are built the way the design system says they should be — measured, not eyeballed — and the highest-risk flow (onboarding with persistence) works end-to-end. A reviewer will be evaluating real, faithful screens.

The conditions: (1) merge the tab-bar fix (or confirm on device that native is unaffected) — reviewers should not see clipped navigation on every screen; (2) either implement or visibly stub the three missing surfaces (Iris reply, outfit detail, Saved) so the review judges intent rather than silence; (3) put GRW-05 on the review agenda as an explicit decision; (4) strip the [7a] debug logs and QA TODOs. Web-specific items (GRW-01/06/07/08/21) are conditions only if web is in scope.

Method: Playwright 1.x + headless Chromium against Metro (dev, __DEV__), persisted-store seeding via localStorage, computed-style/DOM measurement, axe-core 4, three viewport families, 101 scripted assertions with per-step evidence. Harness artefacts (a dev "Bundling…" toast and a portal-neutralisation bug in the harness itself) were identified and excluded before reporting — one candidate finding ("sheet options not tappable") was discarded on that basis.
